Introduction

Weeekly is a six-member South Korean girl group that debuted on June 30, 2020, under IST Entertainment with the mini album "We Are". Originally introduced as FAVEGIRLS in 2018, the group went through lineup and name changes before debuting. Two members left during pre-debut, and Jihan and Zoa were later added.

The group originally had seven members, but Shin Jiyoon went on hiatus twice due to anxiety and eventually left in June 2022, after which Weeekly continued as six. Following her departure, the group remained largely inactive until releasing the digital single "Good Day (Special Daileee)" in September 2023.

On February 26, 2025, it was reported that all members had left IST Entertainment, but no official statement about the group's status or future has been made.
